ABOUT.LIBELLE: Mr Fix Repair is a company that repairs and sells electronic and computer equipment.
ABOUT.ONE: Mr Fix is ​a company specializing in the maintenance, diagnostics, and repair of electronic and IT equipment, offering reliable and sustainable solutions to both individuals and businesses. We service a wide range of equipment—computers, peripherals, IT systems, and electronic devices—while also selling high-quality electronic and IT equipment, carefully selected to meet the highest standards of performance, security, and longevity. With proven technical expertise, responsive customer service, and a constant commitment to excellence, Mr Fix supports its clients in optimizing, securing, and ensuring the long-term viability of their technological infrastructures.

TWO.CARD_CONTENT: Our qualified technicians provide accurate diagnosis and effective interventions on your electronic and IT equipment, regardless of its complexity.

THREE.CARD_CONTENT: We use reliable components and proven methods to ensure durable repairs and high-performing equipment over the long term.

FOUR.CARD_CONTENT: We place customer satisfaction at the heart of our commitment through attentive listening, controlled deadlines and personalized support.
